items.title: Hal Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997
items.q: Hal has played behind many stars of mainstream jazz, including Bob Wilber, Doc Cheatham, Jim Cullum and Milt Hinton.

ctx.x: So there you go. © Fillius Jazz Archive -8-
What are you going to do? But then, for every experience like that there’s Doc Cheatham, or Milt Hinton. And you walk off the bandstand thinking boy I’m glad I did that. So they make up for it.
You’ve been involved in some jazz education projects?
